Everyday rotation.

The things you use every day deserve a little more attention. A database workbench, a clearer view of your drive, and small tools that make the desktop better.

based

A native database workbench for SQL Server, Snowflake, and LanceDB. The AI can see your tabs, use database tools, and put results into your workspace.

Explore basedSource code

Hoardini

Work out what the big files actually are. Hoardini gathers evidence, explains what it finds, and helps you choose what to delete, shrink, move, or keep.

Windowsill Coming soon

A growing suite of small Windows tools, including Glint and Skedaddle. Glint watches the machine from the tray; Skedaddle makes the next meeting harder to miss.

Explore GlintExplore Skedaddle

Keep the thinking local.

The compute is already yours. These projects explore what a browser, a small model, and an overlooked NPU can do with it.

BlabberStack

Chat, generate images, and search your documents in your browser, on your own hardware. Download the models, then run locally without an inference server or account.

Zest

Put an AMD Ryzen AI NPU to work on long prompts through Lemonade and llama.cpp, using existing GGUF models. An experimental preview; speedups depend on the model and hardware.

Model experiments

Smaller models, cheaper experiments, and write-ups of the wins and failures. Includes Qwen pruning and titler, a 4 MB GGUF that turns a prompt into a short title.

Read the experimentsTry titler in your browser

phlegm

Open kernels and runtime work for AMD’s XDNA2 NPU. Real model benchmarks run through the C++ engine; the CLI and server are still being integrated.

Deep cuts & works in progress.

Useful little interventions in the way we build software, and ideas that are still asking interesting questions.

dibs

Parallel agents, one machine. Call dibs on the GPU, NPU, network, or test database so sessions take turns instead of colliding.

smoosh Coming soon

A Claude Code plugin that uses a smaller, faster model to summarize long conversations. Keep the context and get back to work.

SandwichTS

Let an in-app copilot perform a sequence of actions in one script. Sandboxed code gets explicit access to live client-side state, rather than unrestricted access to the app.

Covenant Agent

A tiny model that writes a tool-calling program. The compiler and sandbox are built; the decoder and NPU runtime remain experimental.

Wrangle

A desktop Markdown workspace with live preview, WYSIWYG editing, math, and diagrams.

Claude database tools

A SQL Server CLI and MCP server for Claude Code. A direct connection between the agent and the database.
